I worked through all 61 rules in the conventions checklist against `f306e397e...HEAD` (14 files, +221/−56). Eight rules apply to this diff. Five of them are clean and three flag problems, plus one written repo rule from outside the checklist. The checklist itself is only a temporary file in my scratchpad. No tracked files were changed, no tests were run and nothing was posted.

## Findings

### 1. CODE-01: a fourth copy-address component instead of reusing an existing one
- **`apps/web/src/components/common/CopyAddressIconButton/index.tsx:12`**
- The app already has at least three copy-address components:
  - `components/common/SpaceSafeBar/AccountsModal/shared.tsx:181` (`CopyAddressButton`: lucide `Copy` icon, `size-3.5`, `p-0.5 rounded hover:bg-muted`, "Copy address" label). This is nearly the same markup as the new component.
  - `features/spaces/components/SafeSelectorDropdown/components/CopyAddressButton.tsx:8`
  - `components/common/CopyAddressButton` and `CopyButton`, both built on `CopyTooltip`.
- The PR removes the inline copy from `SafeCardReadOnly`, but leaves the near-identical `shared.tsx` version in place. The two now behave differently: a check icon for 2s versus a "Copied" tooltip for 750ms.
- **Fix:** make `CopyAddressIconButton` the one version. Move `SpaceSafeBar/AccountsModal/shared.tsx` over to it (or turn `CopyButton` into it), and add a note to the PR about the other two.

### 2. CODE-02: the same address-plus-copy layout is pasted into 7 places
- The same wrapper, `<div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1.5">` + address text + `<CopyAddressIconButton>`, appears at:
  - `features/myAccounts/components/AccountsWidget/AccountItemContent.tsx:26`
  - `AccountsWidget/AccountWidgetItem.tsx:38`
  - `MyAccountsV2/components/AccountItem/MultiAccountItem.tsx:152`
  - `MyAccountsV2/components/AccountItem/SingleAccountItem.tsx:64`
  - `SecurityHub/components/SecuritySafesTable/MultichainSafeRow.tsx:220`
  - `SelectSafesOnboarding/components/SafeCardLayout.tsx:85`
  - `SingleSafeRow.tsx:94` has the same idea as an MUI `Stack`.
- **Fix:** give the shape a name, e.g. an `AddressWithCopy` component (or a `children`/`label` slot on `CopyAddressIconButton`), so the spacing and truncation stay the same everywhere.

### 3. TEST-01: the clipboard mock sends tests down the "copy failed" path
- Affected mocks:
  - `apps/web/src/components/common/CopyAddressIconButton/index.test.tsx:7`
  - `features/myAccounts/components/AccountsWidget/__tests__/AccountsWidget.test.tsx:86`
  - `MyAccountsV2/components/AccountItem/__tests__/MultiAccountItem.test.tsx:135`
  - `SelectSafesOnboarding/components/__tests__/SafeCardLayout.test.tsx:76`
- `CopyTooltip` calls `navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(...)`. A bare `jest.fn()` returns `undefined`, so `.then` throws.
- The `catch` then sets `isCopyEnabled=false` and shows the tooltip "Copying is disabled in your browser". Every "copies the address" test is really running the failure path.
- They still pass because they only check that `writeText` was called. If copying broke after that call, no test would notice.
- **Fix:** use `jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined)`, and in the component test also check that the tooltip changes to "Copied".

### 4. TEST-02: the Space-key branch has no test
- **`apps/web/src/components/common/CopyAddressIconButton/index.tsx:14`** handles `Enter || ' '`, but `index.test.tsx:33` only tests Enter.
- Removing the `' '` case would not fail any test.

### 5. PROD-01: visible copy behaviour changed in `SafeCardReadOnly`
- **`apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/SafeAccounts/SafeCardReadOnly.tsx:136`**
- The old copy was a real `<button>`: a green check icon plus a "Copied!" tooltip for 2s.
- It is now a `<span role="button">` with a "Copied" tooltip for 750ms and no check icon.
- This is probably fine, since it is the point of unifying the component. But it is a visible change, so the PR description should say design agreed to it.

### 6. Storybook story missing (outside the checklist; rule at `apps/web/AGENTS.md:10` and `:147`)
- **`apps/web/src/components/common/CopyAddressIconButton/index.tsx:1`**
- The web guidelines require a `.stories.tsx` for every new component that has logic. `CopyAddressIconButton` has a unit test but no story. Next to it, `CopyAddressButton` has both a story and a story snapshot test.

## Rules that apply and pass
- **FEAT-01 / FEAT-03:** features import `@/components/common/CopyAddressIconButton` directly, which is allowed. No feature imports its own barrel.
- **UI-01:** only Tailwind theme-token classes are used, no hard-coded colours.
- **UX-01:** address text still truncates, or wraps with `break-all` when highlighting similar addresses, inside a `min-w-0` flex parent.
- **TEST-01 (click propagation tests):** these would catch a regression.
  - The `MultiAccountItem` test checks that `subacounts-container` is absent, and Radix `CollapsibleContent` doesn't render that while closed.
  - The `SafeCardLayout` test checks that `onToggle` was not called.
  - `CopyTooltip` calls `stopPropagation` and `preventDefault`.
- **UX-03:** `NestedSafesList` only gains `showCopyButton`, so no shell features were removed.

I didn't need to look up any rule's review learnings (no Level 1 or Level 2 lookups), and no findings are left as open questions.
